Explore the odd corners of the map, chase the strange random events, and keep an eye on the community guides: this is one of the five hidden trophies with no confirmed method yet.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by. That means attacking from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon, rather than shooting: drive past enemies and swing at them as you pass. A bike is the easiest platform, since you can swing freely while riding. Find a group of enemies on foot, ride past at speed and connect the hit. The trophy pops on the knockdown, so you only need one clean connection.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are the dirty cash you pick up from robberies and heists, and your contacts clean them for a cut. Keep robbing, keep laundering, and the total adds up across the whole game: $250,000 is a lot, so treat it as a background goal while you work the robbery trophies. Check your contacts menu to see how much you have laundered so far.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Every purchase counts: weapons, clothes, food, car mods and property upgrades all add to the total. You will spend a lot of this naturally while gearing up for the other trophies, so do not force it early: play normally, buy what you need, and check the total in the stats menu. If you are short near the end, car customization is the fastest way to burn the last few thousand.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property in Leonida. Garages are the properties that give you vehicle storage, and they are sold through the in-game property listings. You need all of them, so save up and buy each one as it becomes available: some only unlock as the story opens up new areas. Check the property menu to see which garages you still do not own, and keep enough cash in reserve for the expensive ones.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app lets you register vehicles you find around Leonida, and each new registration counts once. Drive anything you have not registered yet, open the Scooter Bros app and add it: sports cars, bikes, trucks and odd finds all count. Ten is a small number, so this is a quick trophy once the app is available: just register the first ten different vehicles you drive.
